items.title: Bonus, dividends, rights issues and stock splits: TCS, Vedanta, Ola Electric among 14 stocks turning ex-record date this week
items.description: Around 14 companies, including TCS, Vedanta and Ola Electric Mobility, have key corporate action dates scheduled between October 12 and 16. The announcements cover dividends, bonus issues, rights issues, stock splits and share consolidations.

items.title: In a world no one forecast, own a business that outlives presidential social posts: 6 large-cap stocks with upside potential of up to 29%
items.description: For quite some time now, it has become increasingly hard to make sense of what is happening in the world. The old understanding of what is sensible and nonsensical has vanished, and things once kept hidden in the darkest corners are now done openly by those in charge of the most powerful places on earth. So, for the next two-and-a half years, until this phase of global politics runs its course, we will continue to see the kind of surprises that no business can plan for.

items.title: Two Trades for Today: A liquor major for a 5.45% rise, a mid-cap private bank stock for a gain of about 5%
items.description: Our technical analysts identify select stocks every trading day that may gain momentum even in volatile markets. Here are the technical calls for today.

items.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide D-Street action on Monday
items.description: Sensex and Nifty snapped their eight-week losing streak on Friday, surging over 1% as IT stocks rallied and crude prices eased. The rebound added more than Rs 4 lakh crore to BSE-listed companies’ market capitalisation, while positive market breadth favoured bulls.

items.title: 9 stocks zoom up to 37% in 3 months; MFs raise stakes in September quarter
items.description: Of the BSE 500 companies, around 68 have reported their September 2026 quarter shareholding data. Mutual funds increased their stakes in approximately 44 of these companies compared with the June 2026 quarter. Interestingly, most of these stocks delivered negative returns over the past three months despite higher mutual fund holdings. However, nine stocks bucked the trend, delivering double-digit returns of up to 37% as mutual funds raised their stakes during the September quarter. (Data source: ACE Equity)

items.title: Ashish Kacholia, Mukul Agrawal, others invest Rs 120 crore in IPO-bound Fusion CX
items.description: Ace investors Ashish Kacholia and Mukul Agrawal-backed Sanshi Fund, along with Kotak Mahindra Life Insurance, acquired a combined 3.19% stake worth Rs 120 crore in Fusion CX ahead of its Rs 702 crore IPO opening on October 14.

items.title: FII selloff intensifies! Foreign investors sell Indian equities worth Rs 45,000 crore in just 6 sessions. What can reverse the trend?
items.description: Foreign investors sold Indian equities worth Rs 45,125 crore in October's first six sessions, nearly matching September's outflows. Elevated US bond yields and crude oil prices continue to pressure markets, while inflation data and geopolitical developments could influence the selling trend.

items.title: ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0: What do Shah Rukh Khan and SIFs have in common? Radhika Gupta explains
items.description: Edelweiss Mutual Fund MD and CEO Radhika Gupta says investors should approach Specialised Investment Funds (SIFs) with clear portfolio goals rather than chase new products or returns. Speaking at the ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0, she highlighted their tax efficiency, the importance of understanding derivatives-based strategies, and the need to assess risks, costs and realistic return expectations before investing.

items.title: NTPC invites industrial partners for 26% equity in co-generation projects
items.description: NTPC Limited invited Expressions of Interest from commercial and industrial entities willing to invest 26 per cent equity in co-generation projects, according to the state-run power company.

items.title: 9 penny stocks surged up to 315% in 6 months; 3 turned multibaggers
items.description: Over the last six months, nine penny stocks delivered returns ranging from 25% to 315%. The stocks were shortlisted using specific filters: a market capitalisation of less than Rs 1,000 crore, a share price below Rs 20, and a minimum latest trading volume of 5 lakh shares. These criteria helped identify low-priced, actively traded micro-cap stocks that recorded strong price momentum during the period. (Data Source: ACE Equity)

items.title: Weekly Market Outlook: Nifty snaps 8-week losing streak, but can bulls reclaim the crucial 200-week moving average?
items.description: The Nifty snapped its eight-week losing streak but remains below the crucial 200-week moving average at 22,627. The weekly market outlook points to a possible technical rebound, supported by positive divergences on daily charts, though momentum remains weak. Investors should watch key support and resistance levels, sector rotation trends and a sustained move above the long-term average before turning more bullish.
